Collection of elements in neumorphic style

A 2020 stock-vector sheet of neumorphic knobs, toggles, sliders, and menus, now the lead image of the Wikipedia article.

Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Commons gives the source as Freepik (“collection-elements-neumorphic-style_8507495”), the author as Vectorium, the date as 2020, and a CC BY-SA 4.0 license. It was uploaded on 21 October 2020 by the user Le Paragone, not by the author.

A second file, File:Neumorphism-fixed.jpg (uploaded 29 January 2026 by Awesomecat), corrects the misspelled “Accept” button; the English Wikipedia article Neumorphism uses it.

Observed

  • About thirty controls on a light gray square: two large dials with tick marks, a round knob in a blue ring, a pie selector, a nine-dot grid, toggles, sliders, dropdowns, a “Pop Up” card, media buttons, and round icon buttons.
  • Every control is the same gray as the background, with a white highlight at upper left and a soft gray shadow at lower right. Inputs, slider tracks, and the “Name” field are pressed in.
  • One mid blue fills the selected items, progress segments, and the “Cancel” button. Icons and text are dark gray.
  • Corners are fully round on pills and buttons and about 20 px on cards. Type is a geometric sans-serif (Montserrat-like).

Why it belongs

Stock sheets like this spread the style as ready-made parts. It follows the recipe closely and shows how the style favors physical controls (dials, knobs, rockers) over text.
